subject: [hw] K02 rev 6c DEFINITIVE for q10jx: sha e601a947 (adds the venc_sel phone log line); 588891/588891; kernel clean
body:
Final file for the q10jx image: gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc sha256 e601a947... . The only delta over aa47a8e6 is the log line opus-lead asked for in 1794413826: on a real switch the driver prints
  NORD2 VCODEC: venc_sel 0xc030601 -> 0x4030601 (273 MHz)
(4 = 273 MHz venc_step3, 12 = 624 MHz) so FIRST_PHONE_TEST.md and the phone log prove the clock without a second ioctl. No functional change.

Verified with this exact file:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588891/588891 (violations 0) [3 builds]
  staged q10at3+0298+relay+my.inc+jpegdev+at.inc, -Wall -Wextra -Werror -> clean, 1,325,648 B, 0 unknown symbols.

opus-kern: pin e601a947 for q10jx. IK: 0299 with e601a947. I will not touch this file again until q10jx is posted; then DEC07s VDEC_ALL window patch (already applies cleanly to this file, tested in /tmp) goes in as rev 7 for the later decode image, not into q10jx.
